selection_rule: Highest median net Sharpe (base costs) across the yearly blocks 2015-2019, provided neighbouring settings are similar and no single year dominates; ties go to the baseline. Here the highest-median setting is the baseline in both families, so the choice does not depend on how the two checks are scored.

frozen.note: Settings the final test will use, read from the current scripts. Items marked NOT FOUND are not defined in any script and must be specified before the test.

test.source: user instruction; read by strategies/final_test.py from this file

data.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance (auto_adjust=False, actions=True: Adj Close, Close, Stock Splits, Volume); universe and sectors from Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' (current list)

universe_and_eligibility.universe: current S&P 500 list from Wikipedia (not point-in-time; survivorship bias, planned experiment E006)
universe_and_eligibility.missing_prices: not filled; stock ineligible until rolling windows refill
universe_and_eligibility.sectors: current GICS sector from Wikipedia (not point-in-time)

data_corrections.E004: APPLIED in build_dataset.py via pipeline.clean_data(): spec 3.4 cleaning checklist (duplicate dates removed, zero/negative prices removed, extreme moves beyond +/-50% and stale-price runs of 5+ days flagged, not changed) and one share class per company (keep Class A: GOOGL, FOXA, NWSA; drop GOOG, FOX, NWS)
data_corrections.E007: APPLIED in build_dataset.py: the $5 price filter uses raw_close (Yahoo Close with later splits undone, the actually traded price), not the split-adjusted price, to avoid look-ahead bias
data_corrections.E009: adjusted return set to NaN where |adj return| > 20% and adj and raw-close returns have opposite signs
data_corrections.E010: E009-flagged return restored if Yahoo records a split that day and raw_close/adj_close changes by the split factor within 2%; signals use signal_close (invalid returns counted as 0%)

signals.prices_for_returns: adj_close daily returns (invalid = NaN, treated as 0 in backtest)

frozen.execution_lag: signal at close of day t -> traded at close of t+1 (cost charged then) -> earns returns from t+2 (backtest: w = target.shift(1), held = w.shift(1))

rebalancing.Momentum: monthly, on the last available trading day of each month; weights held until next rebalance

momentum_tails.ranking: eligible stocks only, method='first' (ties broken alphabetically), pct=True

frozen.ma_rule: long if 50-day mean > 200-day mean of signal_close, short if below; eligible stocks only
frozen.weights: equal weight within each side; 100% gross long and 100% gross short

min_names_per_side.rule: a side with fewer names goes to cash (other side unaffected)

cost_scenarios.model: trading cost = bps x sum |change in weights| on the trade day; borrow = bps/yr / 252 x short gross, daily

bootstrap.method: moving-block bootstrap of daily net returns
bootstrap.statistic: annualised Sharpe ratio (mean / std x sqrt(252))
bootstrap.applied_to: every strategy x cost scenario, and the benchmark, over the test period

plot_style.style_sheet: matplotlib default (no style or rcParams set)
plot_style.figure_sizes: set per chart in each script

final_test.reads: config/final.json only (settings); frozen pipeline.py and build_dataset.py (code); dataset version above
final_test.safeguards: stops if any frozen .py or dataset checksum differs; stops if results/final_test exists unless --rerun
